author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I heard from my friends that their company only has Github Copilot for their engineers, and they were told to work within the limit, don't over spend the monthly premium requests.
Github Copilot is changing to token billing starting next month, they are DOOMED.  Their AI bills will be 10x next month, or the engineer has to go back to writing code by hand.
